newsitem.title: UK: S&P raises Eagle Star claims-paying ability rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Eagle Star claims-paying ability rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it raised the claims-paying ability rating of Eagle Star Insurance Co Ltd and the financial strength rating of Eagle Star Life Assurance Co Ltd to A plus from A.

"The upgrades in part reflect a change in S&P's rating methodology which has affected the credit given to the Eagle Star companies for the implicit support provided by its parent, B.A.T Industries Plc (BAT)," S&P said in a statement.
"S&P believes that Eagle Star is strategically important to BAT, although continuity of the rating at this level is dependent on the rating of BAT," it added.
On a stand alone basis, S&P said, the companies have good rating profiles reflecting maintenance of good capitalisation and strong non-life business positions, offset by weak historic earnings.
"There has been widespread press speculation about the possibility of a demerger of BAT's financial services and tobacco interests," said S&P.
"Current ratings do not factor in a demerger," it added.
